question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds start once the returned item reaches our warehouse. UPI and wallet refunds arrive in 1-3 business days; card and net banking refunds take 5-7 business days.

question: I haven't received my refund yet. What should I do?
answer: First check the refund status under My Orders. If it has shown 'Refund completed' for more than 7 business days and the money isn't in your account, contact your bank with the refund reference number (RRN) shown there, or chat with us and we'll raise it with the payment partner.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Open My Orders, pick the item and tap Return. Choose a reason and a pickup slot; our courier collects it from your address. Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Innerwear, perishable groceries, personal care items once opened, customised products and digital codes can't be returned. The product page shows 'Non-returnable' for these.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery works on orders up to Rs 50,000 at most pincodes, with a Rs 20 handling fee. You can pay the delivery agent in cash or by UPI.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders and tap Track. We also send tracking links by SMS and WhatsApp once the order ships.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Metro cities usually get orders in 2-4 days and other locations in 4-7 days. The exact date shows on the product page after you enter your pincode.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel for free from My Orders until the order ships. After it ships, refuse the delivery or return it after it arrives.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Yes, until the order ships. Open My Orders, choose the order and tap Change address. The new address must be serviceable for that item.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, popular wallets, EMI and Cash on Delivery.

question: Do you offer EMI?
answer: No-cost EMI is available on orders above Rs 3,000 with select bank cards, and standard EMI on most credit cards. The options show at checkout.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What now?
answer: Failed payments are automatically reversed by your bank within 5-7 business days. If you placed the order again, you won't be charged twice for it.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: On the checkout page, tap Apply Coupon and enter the code. Only one coupon can be used per order.

question: Why is my coupon not working?
answer: Coupons fail when they have expired, the cart is below the minimum order value, or the items are excluded from the offer. Check the coupon's terms on the offers page.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Yes, clothing and footwear can be exchanged for another size within 7 days of delivery if it's in stock. Use Exchange in My Orders.

question: I received a damaged or wrong item. What should I do?
answer: Report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders, with photos of the item and packaging. We'll arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or a full refund.

question: Is delivery free?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499. Smaller orders have a Rs 40 delivery fee. Plus members get free delivery on all orders.

question: Do you deliver to my pincode?
answer: Enter your pincode on any product page to check delivery and the expected date. We deliver to most pincodes in India.

question: How do I get a GST invoice?
answer: Enter your GSTIN and business name at checkout before paying. The GST invoice can then be downloaded from My Orders.

question: What is Plus membership?
answer: Plus costs Rs 999 a year and gives free delivery on all orders, faster shipping and early access to sales.

question: How do I cancel my Plus membership?
answer: Go to Account, then Membership, and turn off auto-renew. Benefits continue until the end of the current membership year; the fee already paid is not refunded.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the login screen tap Forgot password, enter your registered mobile number or email, and set a new password using the OTP we send.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account settings and choose Delete account. Your account is deleted after 30 days unless you log in again to cancel the request.

question: How do I contact customer care?
answer: Chat with us 24x7 in the app under Help, or call 1800-000-0000 (toll-free) between 8 am and 10 pm.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Most electronics and appliances carry the brand's warranty. The warranty card is in the box, and claims go to the brand's service centre.

question: Can I choose a delivery date?
answer: Scheduled delivery is available only for large items like furniture and appliances. You can pick a slot at checkout.

question: How do gift cards work?
answer: Add the gift card code at checkout to use its balance. Gift cards are valid for one year and can't be exchanged for cash.

question: Can I order without creating an account?
answer: You need to log in with your mobile number and an OTP to place an order. It takes less than a minute.

question: How can I sell on your platform?
answer: Register on our seller portal with your GSTIN, PAN and bank details. Approval usually takes 2-3 working days.

question: Is it safe to save my card details?
answer: Yes. As per RBI rules, saved cards are stored as tokens and we never keep your full card number or CVV.
